What to do by hand
- B02: the form wants the date split as day / month / year. Once 17/09/2019 is filled in, rewrite it in that shape, with the month as a number (for example, a month printed as a word becomes 01 to 12).
- Phones: I put both numbers under (C), cell. If either one is really a work or home line, move it to (W) or (H). The same goes for B10, B20, B25, B29 and B30.

What is missing (NEEDS-YOU)
- The name of the preschool or daycare in Roseau (header and B08).
- Your daughter's religion (B04). You can write "None" if that fits, or ask the school whether it is optional.
- The date she finished her immunizations (B06). This should be on her vaccination record. The school will probably ask for a copy too.
- The exact start day in January 2027 (B07). I have filled in the month (01) and year (2027).
- Email addresses for you and your wife (B11, B21, B26).

Things to check
- Address: as you asked, I used your current home address everywhere (B05, B15, B19, B24). I assumed your wife lives there too. Send the school your Dominica address once you have it.
- Your daughter's passport expires on 1 January 2027, which is when she is meant to start and when you move. Renew it well before you travel. Once the new passport is issued, update her passport details in mdoc.
- Your only emergency contacts are the two of you. The school may want someone local in Dominica who can be reached if neither of you answers. If you find someone, give me their name and number and I'll add them.
